title: Get back to earlier work
intro: You closed the terminal yesterday in the middle of a task. Pick how you start Claude Code today.

show.title: The last session reopens
show.detail: Claude Code reopens the most recent conversation in this folder, with its full history.

trace.text: Loads the latest session for this project.

show.title: You pick from a list
show.detail: A searchable list of this folder's sessions opens; choose the one you want to continue.

show.title: A copy to experiment in
show.detail: The conversation is forked into a new session, so you can try another approach while the original stays as it was.

trace.text: Creates a new session from this point.

show.title: A fresh session
show.detail: Plain claude starts a new conversation. The old one is still saved and can be resumed later.

fallback.title: Pick an option
fallback.detail: Choose one of the options to see what happens.

quiz.question: Where are sessions saved?
options: Locally, tied to the project folder
quiz.explanation: Sessions are stored on your machine per project, which is why --continue picks up the latest one in the current folder.
